## Type of change

- [ ] New tool
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Improvement to an existing tool
- [ ] Documentation

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass locally
- [ ] Files are still processed entirely in the browser (no new uploads)
- [ ] For a new tool: registry entry, processor, workspace UI, and the checklist line in
      `docs/{category}_tools.md` are all updated (see
      [docs/architecture.md](../docs/architecture.md))
- [ ] Tested in the browser, including a mobile viewport, not just the type checker
- [ ] Screenshots included for any visual change
